prompt: Create variables `name` (`"Ana"`) and `age` (`30`) and print `Ana is 30 years old` using an f-string.

run.output:
Ana is 30 years old
str int

solution:
name = "Ana"
age = 30
print(f"{name} is {age} years old")
explanation: Variables store values; an f-string puts them into text.
